goal_text: (Reused from sequential_011) Alice, Bob, Carol are suspects. Exactly one committed the crime. Each makes exactly one statement: Alice says 'Bob is guilty.', Bob says 'I am innocent.', Carol says 'Alice is innocent.' Exactly one of the three statements is true. Who committed the crime? Show your full reasoning.
ground_truth: If Alice guilty: Alice stmt=FALSE; Bob stmt=TRUE (he is innocent); Carol stmt=FALSE. Exactly 1 true. ✓ If Bob guilty: Alice=TRUE; Bob=FALSE; Carol=TRUE. 2 true. ✗ If Carol guilty: Alice=FALSE; Bob=TRUE; Carol=TRUE. 2 true. ✗ Answer: Alice committed the crime.
